notes: lightkurve measures a star's light from its pixels: the aperture, the light curve and the regression of the sky's own variation out of it (RegressionCorrector).
astropy's LombScargle finds the period of a light curve.
lightkurve warns that its pixel-response model needs oktopus; that part is not used.
star-privateer computes the wavelet power spectrum and the autocorrelation of a light curve: two of the three period methods of Reinhold & Hekker (2020), whose criteria methods.mts applies.
